jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative- Closets
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

  


Richelieu is a leading North American distributor, importer, and manufacturer of specialty hardware and complementary products. Our products are targeted to an extensive customer base of kitchen and bathroom cabinet, storage and closet, home furnishing and office furniture manufacturers, door and window, residential and commercial woodworkers, and hardware retailers including renovation superstores. Richelieu offers customers a broad mix of high\-end products sourced from manufacturers worldwide. With over 144,000 product offerings, 112 locations in North America, and a state\-of\-the\-art field force that passionately serves over 110,000 customers, Richelieu continues to stand in the forefront of a dynamic and ever\-changing industry.



Since 1968, Richelieu has understood the significance and impact of a strong set of Core Values. Richelieu stands behind these **Five Core Values** that serve as the guiding principles of everything we do: *Customer Focus, Innovation, Performance, Respect/Integrity/Ethics, and Ownership.*



These values are what allow us to achieve **Our Mission:** *to enable our customers to profitably grow their businesses through the design and creation of exceptional kitchens, closets, and storage spaces.*


**Our Opportunity**  

  

We are seeking an **Inside Sales Representative** to join our team of professionals in our branch location for a Monday \- Friday, day shift role, selling and supporting our customers with a large variety of cabinet\-making and storage solution products. We invite you to visit us at Richelieu.com to learn more.


**Why Work for Richelieu?**



Being a member of the Richelieu team means that you are part of something bigger than just yourself. As a growing and winning international organization that places emphasis on its people and culture, its career development opportunities, and the realization that healthy living is in part achieved by the proper balance of work and home, we are excited to be a company that our employees are passionate about!


**Key Responsibilities**

  


As a critical and meaningful role within the Richelieu organization, the **Inside Sales Representative** is primarily responsible for inside sales development for a portion of our local sales region. This person will represent Richelieu products, primarily serving the cabinet\-making industry. This position will be supports for our expanding closets market.


* Assist Richelieu customers by phone, email, and in person at our local branch showroom; research and place orders for our building materials products
* Learn and stay abreast of products, changes, and trends within woodworking, kitchen \& bath design, and cabinet making
* Seek out new business opportunities with customers via phone, placing orders as well as providing sales quotes
* Work closely with outside sales representatives with customer orders and quotes; research pricing and availability for various items in multiple product categories
* Research product solutions for customers to solve field\-project issues
* Maintain and uphold Richelieu's Five Core Values while striving to achieve and surpass our company's sales objectives
* Hours of operation are Monday to Friday, day shift only
* Position may require lifting/pushing/carrying items up to 50 pounds


**What We Are Looking For**


* A motivated, customer\-focused individual, eager to provide top\-quality customer experiences when ordering or installing Richelieu products
* Adaptive, responsive to customer and team inquiries, and an excellent communicator by phone, email, and in person
* Prior inside sales, or customer service experience is helpful, ideally at a desktop of office\-based setting
* **Inside telesales experience preferred in the interior or closet designing market.**
* Knowledge of woodworking, cabinetry, kitchen/bath design, architectural hardware, or related building materials experience is helpful
* Strong problem\-solving skills; able to prioritize tasks, organized, and highly comfortable with technology (uses AS400 database software daily)
* Strong sense of drive and creativity, ability to communicate persuasively and informatively with all types of customers and coworkers
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; must be able to effectively use Word, Outlook , and Excel for daily responsibilities and tasks
* AS400 experience is helpful, but is not required


**Compensation and Benefits**


* Competitive market\-based hourly rate \+ commission
* Group insurance program (medical, dental, vision, life, disability, etc.)
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan with employer matching
* 401(K) with employer matching
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick days
* Company discount program available


**We are an equal opportunity employer.**

jobs.description:

We believe that holding a seat at your dinner table is the ultimate compliment, and we strive to help families create wholesome, fun, and authentic eating experiences.

The Territory Sales Representative is responsible for the growth of sales of assigned routes. The ideal candidate will establish, maintain, and develop business, social and civic relationships with customers and sales drivers in the assigned territory to maximum profitability.

**Responsibilities:**

* Establish and maintain collaborative relationships with sales drivers, store managers, and key customer decision makers.
* Ensure the company drivers understand the expectation and communicate how he/she will execute and align the goals of the organization. This includes weekly updates. Send all training documentation to the Human Resources Department.
* Ensure sales expectations are met, while delivering high\-quality customer service to various customer accounts.
* Identify leads, manage prospects, and acquire new business.

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Sales Associate**  


**Position Overview**
The Front Desk/Sales Associcate serves as the first point of contact for prospective and current members and plays a critical role in creating an exceptional studio experience. As a brand ambassador for Club Pilates and Aligned Fitness Holdings, this individual is responsible for building relationships, driving membership sales, supporting member retention, and fostering a welcoming studio community.
This role combines sales, customer service, and operational support responsibilities, requiring a highly motivated individual who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is passionate about health, wellness, and helping others achieve their fitness goals.  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Membership Sales \& Business Development**
* Generate new membership sales through proactive outreach, lead follow\-up, and relationship\-building efforts.
* Conduct consultations with prospective members to understand their fitness goals and recommend appropriate membership options.
* Schedule and promote Intro Classes to convert prospects into active members.
* Meet or exceed individual and studio sales goals and key performance metrics.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of all sales activities, communications, and member interactions within ClubReady.

**Member Experience \& Customer Service**
* Deliver exceptional service by warmly greeting members and guests and creating a positive, professional studio atmosphere.
* Build strong relationships with members to enhance engagement, satisfaction, and retention.
* Respond promptly and professionally to phone calls, emails, text messages, and walk\-in inquiries.
* Resolve member concerns or escalate issues appropriately to studio leadership.

**Studio Operations**
* Support daily studio operations, ensuring a clean, organized, and welcoming environment.
* Process member account requests, including freezes, cancellations, and account updates in accordance with company policies.
* Ensure compliance with all Club Pilates and Aligned Fitness Holdings policies, procedures, and service standards.
* Assist with opening and closing studio procedures as assigned.
* Serve as the acting studio leader in the absence of the General Manager when designated.

**Community Outreach \& Brand Awareness**
* Represent the studio at local networking events, community activities, partnerships, and promotional initiatives.
* Support grassroots marketing efforts designed to increase brand awareness and generate new leads.
* Act as a positive ambassador for Club Pilates and Aligned Fitness Holdings within the local community.

**Qualifications and Education Requirements**
**Required**
* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to build rapport and establish trust with diverse individuals.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask and work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Basic computer proficiency, including experience with email, scheduling systems, and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

**Preferred**
* Previous experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, retail, fitness, or wellness industries.
* Experience working toward sales goals, quotas, or performance metrics.
* Familiarity with ClubReady or similar customer relationship management (CRM) systems.

**Success in this Role**
* Successful Sales Representatives consistently:
* Deliver exceptional member experiences.
* Build meaningful relationships within the studio community.
* Achieve membership sales and retention goals.
* Demonstrate accountability, professionalism, and initiative.
* Contribute positively to the culture and success of the studio.

**Physical Requirements**
* Ability to stand and move throughout the studio for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

jobs.title: Strategic Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



The Platform Account Development team drives adoption and growth of the DoorDash Commerce Platform across our SMB restaurant segment (150 locations). We partner closely with Account Management to understand each merchant's first\-party growth goals and activate the right mix of Commerce Platform solutions \- including Online Ordering to accelerate their success. Our mission is to enable every SMB merchant with the tools to grow first party sales, deliver a unique guest experience, and save on costs in order to have a thriving business.


**About the Role**
------------------



As a **Strategic Sales Development Representative**, you will support our Platform team – which focuses on helping merchants adopt DoorDash's Platform solutions, such as Online Ordering and other growth products. In this role, you'll own the early stages of the sales motion – engaging merchants through high\-volume, targeted outreach to uncover needs, identify decision makers, and qualify interest in additional products. You'll work closely with Account Development partners to generate and advance pipeline, ensuring opportunities are clearly scoped and positioned for deeper sales engagement.



You'll engage both new and existing merchants with a thoughtful, consultative approach, tailoring outreach based on merchant context and solution fit. Your work will play a key role in supporting merchant growth by connecting partners with products designed to expand their relationship with DoorDash beyond the marketplace. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast\-paced conversations, brings discipline and creativity to their outreach, and is excited to develop strong solution\-selling fundamentals.



We expect this role to be flexible and will travel as needed for in\-person collaboration through trainings, offsites, team\-building events, and other business related necessity.

* Tailor messaging and discovery based on merchant needs, context, and solution fit
* Strengthen your skills in consultative discovery, value\-based storytelling, and opportunity qualification
* Gain exposure to solution\-selling and account development motions that support merchant growth beyond the marketplace

* 2\+ years of experience in high\-volume outbound outreach or sales development
* A track record of consistently meeting or exceeding activity and performance goals (daily, weekly, or monthly)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage merchants in thoughtful conversations

* Creativity in outreach and messaging that sparks interest and opens doors

* Comfort navigating sales processes and tools in a fast\-paced environment
* A willingness to learn quickly, adapt to change, and incorporate feedback to improve performance

jobs.title: Multifamily Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

The Assistant Project Manager (APM) supports the Project Manager and Superintendent in the successful planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of ground\-up multifamily construction projects. This position is responsible for helping manage project documentation, subcontractor coordination, procurement, cost control, scheduling, change management, and communication between the field, ownership, design team, and subcontractors.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, technically capable, and interested in developing into a Project Manager role within the multifamily construction industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Management \& Coordination**

* Assist the Project Manager with the day\-to\-day management of multifamily construction projects from preconstruction through closeout.
* Coordinate with the Superintendent, subcontractors, architects, engineers, consultants, vendors, and ownership representatives.
* Participate in owner, architect, contractor (OAC) meetings and subcontractor coordination meetings.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action\-item lists, and follow\-up documentation.
* Help identify project risks, delays, scope gaps, and coordination issues before they impact the schedule or budget.

**Submittals \& RFIs**

* Manage and maintain project submittal logs.
* Review subcontractor submittals for completeness prior to forwarding them to the design team.
* Track submittal approvals and ensure materials are released in accordance with the project schedule.
* Prepare, issue, and track Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Coordinate RFI responses with the field team and affected subcontractors.
* Maintain current construction drawings, specifications, ASIs, RFIs, and other project documents.

**Procurement \& Subcontractor Management**

* Assist with subcontractor bidding, bid leveling, scope review, and contract preparation.
* Help confirm subcontractor scopes are complete and consistent with project plans and specifications.
* Track subcontract agreements, purchase orders, insurance requirements, and required documentation.
* Maintain procurement logs for long\-lead materials and equipment.
* Coordinate material releases and delivery requirements with the project schedule.

**Cost Management**

* Assist with maintaining project budgets, commitments, and cost reports.
* Review subcontractor change\-order requests and supporting documentation.
* Prepare potential change orders and owner change\-order documentation.
* Track project contingency, allowances, and pending cost exposures.
* Assist with subcontractor pay applications and monthly owner billing.
* Verify that subcontractor billing corresponds with actual work completed in the field.

**Scheduling**

* Work with the Project Manager and Superintendent to maintain the overall construction schedule.
* Assist with preparation and distribution of two\-week and three\-week look\-ahead schedules.
* Monitor procurement activities and subcontractor commitments against schedule requirements.
* Identify activities that could affect critical\-path construction.
* Help coordinate building turnover, inspections, punch\-list activities, and unit delivery schedules.

**Field Coordination**

* Maintain a regular presence in the field and work closely with the Superintendent and Assistant Superintendent.
* Review construction progress against plans, specifications, and project requirements.
* Participate in quality\-control inspections and punch walks.
* Assist with resolving field coordination issues involving multiple trades.
* Track completion of corrective work and outstanding punch\-list items.
* Help coordinate municipal inspections, third\-party inspections, testing, and owner inspections.

**Project Documentation**

* Maintain organized and accurate electronic project files.
* Track RFIs, submittals, change orders, procurement, inspections, meeting minutes, and other project correspondence.
* Help maintain current drawing sets and ensure field personnel have access to the latest documents.
* Assist in maintaining daily and weekly reporting as required.
* Document significant project issues and decisions through written correspondence.

**Project Closeout**

* Coordinate collection of warranties, attic stock, spare materials, operation and maintenance manuals, and closeout documentation.
* Track subcontractor punch\-list completion.
* Assist with obtaining final inspections, Certificates of Occupancy, and other required approvals.
* Coordinate turnover documentation with ownership and property management.
* Assist with subcontractor final payments, lien releases, and project financial closeout.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Building Construction, Engineering, Architecture, or related field preferred.
* 3–5 years of commercial or multifamily construction experience preferred.
* Experience with ground\-up multifamily, wood\-frame, podium, garden\-style, wrap, or similar residential construction is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, contracts, submittals, RFIs, and change orders.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing and subcontractor coordination.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and construction management software.
* Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, BuildingConnected, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced construction environment.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to recognize potential scope, cost, and schedule issues.
* Ability to work collaboratively with office and field personnel.

**Preferred Multifamily Experience**

Experience with some or all of the following is preferred:

* Wood\-frame multifamily construction
* Unit turnover and phased building delivery
* Building envelope and waterproofing
* MEP coordination
* Elevators
* Fire

jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant**



As the **Executive Assistant**, you will play a key role in supporting the company’s legal, regulatory, and executive functions. You’ll manage corporate entities, licenses, permits, compliance deadlines, and acquisition\-related activities while providing high\-level administrative support to the President and senior leadership. This role is ideal for a highly organized, discreet, technology\-forward professional who can manage competing priorities, build strong relationships across the organization, and use technology and AI to streamline processes and support a growing company.


**What You’ll Be Doing**


* You will manage the lifecycle of corporate legal entities, including formations, registrations, annual renewals, filings, maintenance, and dissolutions across multiple states and jurisdictions.
* You will oversee liquor licenses, business licenses, food service licenses, hotel licenses, permits, and other regulatory requirements across the company’s properties and locations.
* You will maintain compliance calendars, licensing records, corporate documentation, and audit\-ready files while proactively tracking deadlines and renewals.
* You will coordinate with outside legal counsel, registered agents, government agencies, Accounting, Operations, Human Resources, Business Development, and property leadership to ensure compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time.

* You will assist with due diligence, M\&A activities, financing, audits, and other legal and corporate projects as needed.

* You will manage the transfer, renewal, and closure of licenses associated with property openings, ownership changes, property sales, and entity dissolutions.
* You will support brand and investor administration, including employee ID setups, annual investor tax document distribution, and maintaining accurate property and business unit records.

To be a successful candidate, you will need the following:

* Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, outside counsel, government agencies, and property teams.

* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills with the ability to exercise sound judgment and adapt to changing priorities.

With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.



Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world\-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.

When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You'll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission\-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** Plift is a high\-growth beverage startup offering delicious hemp\-infused drinks that are high on taste and low on calories. Designed for social gatherings, solo moments, and everything in between, Plift focuses on creating enjoyable, approachable products for a wide range of occasions. The brand emphasizes quality ingredients, refreshing flavor profiles, and a relaxed, inclusive experience. Team members join a growing company in a dynamic consumer packaged goods space with opportunities to contribute to brand expansion and market presence.

**Role Description** The Sales Operations Coordinator is a full\-time, remote role for our Chicago\-based company. We will be prioritizing candidates who are local to Chicago and who can join for weekly in\-person meetings and co\-working days. This role supports the sales team with daily operational tasks, including maintaining sales records, updating customer and account information, and preparing reports and dashboards to track performance. The coordinator will assist with order processing, inventory coordination, and communication between sales, customer service, and distribution partners to ensure smooth execution of sales activities. Responsibilities also include responding to internal and external inquiries, supporting the onboarding of new accounts, and helping streamline processes and tools to improve overall sales efficiency. This position works closely with sales and operations leadership teams to ensure consistent and accurate data entry and data management for decision\-making.

**Year\-one deliverables**

* Take full ownership of the full wholesale order processing cycle from receiving purchase orders to sending invoices, to entering order data into 3PL system, as well as initiating and managing freight.
* Support in the selection and implementation of an ERP by end of Q1 next year.
* Build lot code traceability into every B2B and distributor shipment.
* Cut the time from PO received to invoice issued to under 4 business hours, measured weekly.Cut DSO (days sales outstanding) by 15 days through systematic AR follow\-up.
* Reduce freight cost as a percent of revenue by 1–2 points through carrier negotiation and lane consolidation across all carriers and freight brokers.
* Build a distributor onboarding playbook so the next 10 distributors do not require co\-founder time to get live.

**Day\-to\-day responsibilities**

* Own the full order\-to\-cash lifecycle: PO receipt → invoice → freight booking → BOL → delivery confirmation → payment.
* Coordinate freight with C.H. Robinson and distributor\-managed carriers. Own freight quotes, lane decisions, and freight\-add\-to\-invoice decisions.
* Manage the relationship with 3PLs on warehouse SLAs. Hold them accountable to ship windows and lot code accuracy.
* Reconcile shortages, damages, and mis\-shipments. Issue credit memos through Belay Financial without assistance from Director of Ops or COO.
* Run a weekly ops review with Director of Ops: aging AR, open POs, OOS risk, freight spend, exceptions.
* Be the escalation point for distributor billing disputes

**Required experience**

* 5–8 years in sales operations, supply chain, or order management at a CPG, beverage, or distributed consumer goods company.
* Has personally led at least one ERP implementation or major migration. NetSuite, Fishbowl,

Encompass, or beverage\-specific platform preferred.

* Hands\-on with three\-tier alcohol or hemp beverage distribution. If not, then deep DSD or

wholesale\-broker experience that translates.

* Strong QuickBooks Online familiarity.
* Has owned freight relationships, not just submitted tickets to a 3PL.
* Comfortable in spreadsheets at a power\-user level (pivot tables, lookups, basic SQL or Looker a plus).

**Nice to have﻿**

* Experience with hemp, cannabis, or alcohol regulatory compliance (state\-by\-state license tracking, METRC, MN OCM, etc.).
* Has worked with Belay Financial or another fractional accounting firm.
* Has been the first ops hire at a sub\-$10M revenue company before.

Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60647

Every person should have access to a wholesome, home\-cooked meal at an affordable price.

* Develop and maintain positive relationships with Independent Service Coordination (ISC) agencies, state agencies, healthcare providers, and community partners.

* Strong organizational, documentation, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and computerized database systems.

* Bachelor's degree in Human Services, Social Work, Healthcare Administration, Psychology, Special Education, or a related field.
* Experience working with individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

* Collect files, quotes, invoices, photos, plans, vendor updates, and approval records for reference.
* Escalate delays, missing information, and decision\-needed items to leadership.
* Keep project communication clear, organized, and easy for others to follow.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, restaurant operations, administration, construction coordination, hospitality, or a related field.
* Strong organization and follow\-up skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Comfortable using project trackers, Monday.com, Teams, Excel, Google Drive, SharePoint, or similar tools.
* Ability to work with multiple departments and manage changing priorities.
* Restaurant, hospitality, construction, or operations experience preferred.

This is primarily an in\-office and Field\-support role based in Orange County, CA. The position requires regular in\-person collaboration with leadership, Field teams, vendors, and restaurant locations.

Kei Concepts offers a supportive and growth\-focused work environment with opportunities to be involved in new restaurant openings, brand development projects, and company\-wide initiatives.

**About Valar Atomics**



At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high\-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next\-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory\-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

  


**The Team**



As part of the Business organization, People and Talent attracts, develops, and supports the exceptional individuals who drive Valar's success. The team partners across the company to build a high\-performing organization through recruiting, employee development, engagement, and people operations.

  


**The Role**



We're seeking a Recruiting Coordinator to support our Talent team and own the logistics, coordination, and candidate experience across the hiring process. This role is critical to our ability to scale—ensuring candidates move quickly, interviews run seamlessly, and every interaction reflects the high bar we set for our team. We're looking for someone who's energized by ambiguity, excited to build from the ground up, and quick to take initiative. This is a fully on\-site role based at our Torrance, CA headquarters.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Schedule phone, video, and onsite interviews across multiple teams and time zones with speed and accuracy.
* Deliver a high\-quality candidate experience through clear communication, attention to detail, and confident onsite hosting.
* Maintain accurate candidate records and workflows in our Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse).
* Coordinate candidate travel (flights, hotels, transportation) and support expense reconciliation.
* Improve recruiting operations through process enhancements and special projects.
* Build strong, professional relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring teams across the business to keep the hiring process moving.

  


**Basic Qualifications**


* Experience managing complex calendars and using tools such as Outlook and Microsoft Office.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer\-service mindset.
* High level of organization with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Torrance, CA.

  


**Preferred Skills and Experience**


* 2\+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent operations, or HR coordination.
* Experience using Greenhouse or a similar Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience improving or streamlining recruiting or operational processes.

  


**What We Offer**


* Competitive base salary
* Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
* Comprehensive medical benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite
* Generous PPE stipend
* High\-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy
* Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement
* Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders
* The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

  


**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**



Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.



We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.



Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

new_jobs.title: Recruiting/Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Recruiting Operations Coordinator**
=====================================


**Compensation:** $55,000–$70,000 annually  

**Equity:** Equity included  

**Location:** El Segundo, CA  

**Work Policy:** Onsite  

**Level:** L1  

**Hiring Count:** 1


**Who are we?**
---------------



Rangeview is on a mission to build the foundry system that reindustrializes America. We exist to break the legacy manufacturing trap by reinventing critical production for the twenty\-first century.



Through advanced software, deep automation, breakthroughs in materials science, and modern financing strategies, Rangeview rewrites both the cost curve and the power structure of making metal parts.


**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------



This is an opportunity to join Rangeview early in your career and gain hands\-on exposure to recruiting, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, and the teams building the future of American manufacturing.



You do **not** need previous recruiting experience. We're looking for someone with strong coordination and operational instincts who is excited to learn.



You'll work directly with our Talent Acquisition Lead and gradually take on increasing responsibility across recruiting operations, sourcing, candidate engagement, and other recruiting projects.



For someone who excels, there is significant room to grow as Rangeview grows. Depending on your strengths, interests, performance, and future business needs, that could mean developing further within recruiting or gaining exposure to other operational areas of the company.


**What will you do?**
---------------------


* Own interview scheduling and coordination across candidates, hiring managers, and interview teams.
* Serve as a responsive and professional point of contact for candidates throughout the recruiting process.
* Coordinate onsite interviews, including schedules, candidate logistics, rooms, and interviewer communication.
* Greet candidates arriving for onsite interviews and ensure they have a welcoming, organized experience.
* Provide front\-desk coverage when Rangeview is hosting scheduled tours, important visitors, or other significant guests.
* Maintain accurate candidate, interview, and requisition information in Greenhouse.
* Track recruiting activity and proactively follow up on outstanding feedback, scheduling needs, and next steps.
* Support job postings, interview plans, scorecards, offer administration, and recruiting documentation.
* Help maintain recruiting dashboards, trackers, and reporting.
* Support candidate sourcing and outreach as you develop in the role.
* Assist with recruiting events, career fairs, and other talent initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve recruiting workflows and build more scalable processes.
* Take on increasing recruiting responsibilities based on interest, performance, and business needs.

**What will you need?**
-----------------------


* 1\+ year of experience in a coordination\-heavy environment such as supply chain, logistics, operations, recruiting, HR, project coordination, customer operations, or a similar role.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple schedules, priorities, stakeholders, and moving pieces simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* A proactive approach—you notice what needs to happen next and take action without waiting to be asked.
* Sound judgment and the ability to prioritize when multiple things need attention.
* Resourcefulness and comfort figuring things out when there isn't an established process.
* A personable, professional presence and comfort interacting with candidates, employees, executives, and visitors.
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving environment where priorities and processes continue to evolve.
* Working knowledge of Google Workspace or similar productivity tools.
* Interest in learning recruiting and developing your career at Rangeview.
* Ability to work onsite in El Segundo, CA.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience in supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, operations, recruiting, HR, or people operations.
* Experience coordinating complex calendars or multi\-person schedules.
* Experience with Greenhouse or another applicant tracking system.
* Experience with ERP, CRM, or other workflow\-management systems.
* Experience with spreadsheets, reporting, dashboards, or process documentation.
* Experience creating or improving processes and SOPs.
* Experience in a startup, aerospace, defense, manufacturing, hardware, or other fast\-paced technical environment.
* Candidate sourcing or LinkedIn Recruiter experience.


**A bachelor's degree is not required.**


**Compensation**
----------------



The salary range for this position is **$55,000–$65,000 annually \+ equity**.



Salary is based on demonstrated experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.



Rangeview offers a competitive benefits package, including equity, unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision insurance.


**Additional Requirements**
---------------------------


* Must be able to work onsite in El Segundo, CA.
* Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.
* Must meet Rangeview's ITAR eligibility requirements.

**Compliance**
--------------



Rangeview is a DDTC\-registered, ITAR\-compliant business. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.



Rangeview is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Rangeview is governed on the basis of merit and aptitude and will not be influenced in any manner by any legally protected status.

new_jobs.title: Partner Account Manager - Los Angeles (Santa Clarita)
new_jobs.description:
**Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.**



More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it's because they are employed by a company that doesn't offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium\-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.



We're a high\-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.


**About the role**



Our Partnership Program is a key initiative for the company. The Partner Account Manager's primary duty is to engage, build and develop Human Interest's key accounts and growth opportunities. We're looking for a forward\-thinking, meticulously organized, and self\-motivated sales professional who can thrive in a fast\-paced environment. You'll accelerate our partner relationships to help us exponentially reach more small and medium businesses across the United States, which is essential to our growth. This role requires someone who is proactive, creative, and can exercise their own discretion and judgment to create their own solutions when needed.


**What you get to do every day**


* Develop, build, and amplify referral relationships with tech partners, human capital management partners, benefit brokers, CPA's and financial advisors in the SMB space
* Create and build strategic referral networks and partnerships focused on lead generation and new partnership opportunities
* Proactively identify and resolve emerging issues and offer solutions by working cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Marketing, Legal and Finance
* Collaborate with Partner Marketing to innovate and execute unique initiatives to promote partner sales (e.g, educational events, email, webinars, etc.)
* Work with partners to establish business goals and performance metrics (e.g, depth of sales pipeline and revenue generation) to develop and execute effective go\-to\-market strategies and demand\-generation activities


**What you bring to the role**


* 2\+ years of experience building, developing, and maintaining relationships with tech and human capital management (HCM) partners, benefit brokers, CPA's and financial advisors in the SMB space *(including territory sales and business development)*
* Successful \- Proven track record of success in a quota driven sales environment
* Passionate \- You are a highly motivated individual contributor and relationship builder that can operate independently
* Dynamic \- You can thrive in a fast\-paced, and ever\-changing environment
* Resilient—You bounce back from setbacks quickly, are resourceful, and find creative ways to get things done.
* Solutions\-oriented \- Willingness to get your hands dirty while managing and solving operational partnership issues
* Extraordinary communication and interpersonal skills — people trust you and sense that you are advocating for something you believe.
* Tech\-savvy \- familiarity using Salesforce to manage sales cycles is preferred
* Growth mindset \- You can embrace feedback and hold yourself accountable.
* Coachable\- Ability to absorb information, training, and guidance and successfully implement and execute
* Travel \- Ability to be In the field 3 days/week, must be located in the **Santa Clarita** area


**Why you will love working at Human Interest**



Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges \- closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium\-sized businesses nationwide. We've made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission\-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.



Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.



Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest's unique view on what's important and what's right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.


* **Customer obsession**: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
* **Long\-Term Orientation**: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
* **Autonomous and Accountable Teams**: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
* **An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance**: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
* **Fundamental Optimism**: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.


**Compensation** \- At Human Interest, we consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate pay range for each position, including the cost of labor in different markets across the U.S. The total On Target Earnings (OTE) for the role described in this job posting is $140,000 to $150,000 which includes a base salary of $80,000 to $90,000, and a variable target compensation of $60,000\. The specific pay rate offered is based on the candidate's relevant skills and experience. Base pay i

new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Pet Specialty
new_jobs.description:
**Key Account Manager – Pet Specialty**  

**Location:** Torrance, CA (In\-Office)  

**Reports to:** Sr. Sales Manager  

**Category Focus:** Pet Specialty  

  

**About Inaba Foods (USA) Inc.**  

Inaba Foods is a manufacturer of premium pet food, treats, toppers, and complements, deeply rooted in a family tradition of excellence that spans generations. Since 1958, pet parents have trusted Inaba to deliver products that are human\-grade, nutrient\-rich, and designed to bring joy to pets.  

  

Today, Inaba is the most popular brand of premium cat and dog dinners and treats in Japan, with growing distribution throughout the United States and globally. Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. continues to expand its footprint, invest in talent, and build long\-term partnerships across the pet industry, supported by the stability and vision of our Japanese parent company.  

  

**Position Summary**  

Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. is seeking a Key Account Manager – Pet to develop and manage strategic relationships at the headquarters and regional level with national and regional retailers, as well as distributors, within the Pet Specialty channel. This role is responsible for driving growth, expanding distribution, and strengthening long\-term partnerships while collaborating closely with internal teams to execute sales strategies.  

  

This is a full\-time, in\-office position based in Torrance, CA, as required by company leadership.  

  

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Grow distribution and sales volume within assigned Pet Specialty accounts
* Strengthen distributor relationships to expand market presence and execution
* Become a trusted partner to customers through strategic planning and consistent engagement
* Contribute to category growth through promotions, pricing strategies, and market insights
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to support forecasting, production planning, and account strategy

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and distributors, nurturing existing business and driving incremental growth
* Analyze historical and current purchase order data to project sales, assess profitability, and identify growth opportunities
* Lead and participate in customer business reviews and market presentations
* Maintain regular engagement with accounts to ensure customer needs are met or exceeded
* Execute promotional strategies and programs to drive volume and brand visibility
* Provide sales forecasts and input for production and demand planning
* Collaborate with executive leadership on pricing, promotions, quotes, and account strategies
* Resolve customer issues related to product, service, or sales execution
* Monitor competitive activity, market trends, and merchandising techniques
* Manage expenses in alignment with budgeted guidelines
* Demonstrate a growth\-oriented, proactive sales approach focused on building and expanding strategic relationships
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards while representing Inaba in a professional manner
* Perform additional duties as assigned

 **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field
* 3–7 years of experience in sales within Pet Specialty, Food \& Beverage, or adjacent CPG categories
* Experience calling on headquarters, regional offices, and/or managing distributor relationships
* Strong ability to analyze trends, data, and sales performance metrics
* Proficiency in creating compelling PowerPoint sales presentations
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities
* Experience working cross\-functionally with internal teams and external partners
* Ability to travel locally or regionally as needed, including time spent in the field
* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software

 **Why Join Inaba Foods**

* Growing U.S. business with expanding distribution and increasing market presence
* Long\-term stability and leadership from a well\-established Japanese parent company
* Opportunity to manage meaningful accounts and influence growth strategy
* Collaborative, professional environment with a strong brand reputation

  

Inaba Foods is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment laws, including California’s Fair Employment and Housing Act.

  

This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

new_jobs.title: Automotive Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking an energetic and results\-driven Automotive Business Development Representative to join our dynamic sales team. In this role, you will be the driving force behind expanding our automotive sales footprint by building strong relationships with prospective clients and dealership partners. Your enthusiasm for high\-end automotive sales, combined with your exceptional communication skills, will help you identify new business opportunities, negotiate deals, and close sales effectively. This paid position offers a fantastic opportunity to grow within the automotive industry while making a tangible impact on our company's success.

**Responsibilities**

* Engage in outbound sales efforts through cold calling and outreach to potential clients and dealership networks to generate new leads and expand the sales pipeline
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships by providing excellent service, understanding client needs, and offering tailored automotive financing options and solutions
* Conduct B2B sales negotiations with dealership managers and fleet clients to secure high\-value deals and upsell additional products or services
* Manage the entire deal closing process, ensuring smooth transactions from initial contact through final agreement
* Utilize CRM software to track client interactions, manage sales pipelines, and support ongoing customer relationship management efforts
* Present compelling product demonstrations and public speaking engagements to promote our automotive offerings effectively
* Collaborate with sales support teams to ensure inventory management aligns with customer demand and organizational goals

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in outside sales, B2B sales, or retail automotive sales, preferably within the passenger car segment
* Demonstrated success in achieving or exceeding sales targets through effective deal closing and upselling strategies
* Strong negotiation skills complemented by excellent phone etiquette and client communication abilities
* Multilingual or bilingual capabilities are highly desirable to serve diverse customer bases effectively
* Familiarity with automotive financing options, inventory control, and CRM systems supported by technical tools
* Exceptional organizational skills with a keen eye for retail math, inventory management, and maintaining a robust sales pipeline
* Experience in dealership environments or automotive industry sales is preferred but not required; a passion for cars and customer service is essential

Join us as an Automotive Business Development Representative if you're ready to energize your career in high\-end automotive sales! Bring your negotiation prowess, organizational talent, and enthusiasm for building lasting customer relationships to a team that values your drive for success.

Pay: From $45,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) 4% Match
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid training
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Project Coordinator provides administrative and operational support to the Project Management team, with primary responsibility for supporting the Order Intake process.

This role is responsible for processing incoming RFQs, supporting opportunity and project setup, maintaining accurate project information, tracking outstanding items, and assisting with workload and backlog management.

The Project Coordinator works closely with Project Management, Account Management, and other departments to ensure required information is complete, accurately entered into company systems, and moved through the Order Intake process in a timely manner.

**Responsibilities**

* Process incoming RFQs and Order Intake activities.
* Support opportunity and project setup within company systems.
* Enter, update, and maintain accurate opportunity and project information.
* Review incoming information for completeness and accuracy.
* Coordinate with Account Management and other departments to obtain missing or incomplete information.
* Support pricing, documentation, and submission activities within the established Order Intake workflow.
* Track outstanding RFQs, opportunities, approvals, and required follow\-up.
* Assist with management of the Order Intake workload and backlog.

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 40\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 40\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Company**  

“A perfume is a world you can return to over and over again–a keyhole into far off places–material and imaginary.”  

D.S. \& Durga is a Brooklyn fragrance house on a quest to create thrilling perfumes inspired by music, myth, and the mundane. Founded in 2009 by David (D.S.) and Kavi (Durga) Moltz, the brand is known for its uniquely distinguished perfumes, candles, and aromatic products. All fragrances and design worlds are original compositions, rooted in specificity, surrealism, and clarity.  

With distribution across 600 doors globally and five freestanding stores in NYC and LA, the brand is entering a new phase of growth following Manzanita Capital’s majority investment in 2024\.  

  

**Role Overview**  

D.S. \& Durga is looking for a Social Media Manager to take full ownership of our social strategy — someone who can answer the real question behind this job: how do you make someone smell something through a screen? This isn't a content calendar or a posting schedule; it's the challenge of translating a fragrance into a feeling someone experiences through a rectangle of glass in their hand.  

You'll work directly with our founders, our Art Director, and our fractional CMO to build a social presence as specific and distinct as the brand itself — not a playbook borrowed from every other beauty account, but one that's genuinely ours. You'll also partner closely with our Influencer \& GTM and Commercial teams, since social is only one part of a larger discovery engine: it doesn't stay on the app, it walks into a store, gets sprayed on a wrist at a dinner party, and becomes the reason a stranger asks what you're wearing. Your content should compound moment to moment, not reset the algorithm every Monday.  

This role requires both a rigorous, analytical understanding of how platforms actually work — mechanics, not vibes — and the creative eye and hands to turn that understanding into something beautiful. You'll translate performance data into direction for the rest of the team.  

**Your creative toolkit — Music, Myth \& the Mundane:*** **Music** — "Perfume Is Music" is a working method, not a tagline. You'll build the character of a scent the way you'd build a track: notes, a family, a mood, using playlists, rhythm, and tone.
* **Myth** — Every bottle is a character with a world around it — what they wear, drink, listen to, believe. You'll know how to build that world and translate it into a nine\-second video.
* **The Mundane** — A fork's shadow on white linen, a glass of water, a cassette mid\-play. You'll know how to find the charge in an ordinary object and make it feel like the moment before something happens.

**Priorities, in sequence:*** **Instagram, now** — Reframe our existing assets into content that works on the platform, with sharper editing and sharper instincts for what stops the scroll.
* **TikTok, rebooted** — Restart the experiment. Test, fail fast, iterate, and find a voice that's ours rather than a version of what's already working for everyone else.
* **What's next** — YouTube, emerging platforms, and whatever's coming. You'll help us figure out what's worth chasing and what's noise.

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**Strategy \& Vision*** Full ownership of D.S. \& Durga's social strategy — not just execution, the vision itself.
* Build a strategy that meets our customer where they actually are, in partnership with founders, Art Director and fractional CMO.
* Sequence and build step by step — know what comes first, and why.
* Synthesize the brand's essence into a social context that feels native to each platform, not translated onto it.

**Content, Built from Our Own Pillars*** Character — give every fume its own persona, its own vibe, its own moment.
* Fume — the notes, the family, the samples, told the D.S. \& Durga way.
* Playlist — build the world beyond the bottle; play in formats other brands can't touch.
* World Building — educate on the olfactive range without ever sounding like a brochure.
* Fan Mail — go beyond the algorithm; build the culture club with our most committed fans.
* Merchandise — make the b(r)and visible, collectible, IYKYK.
* Be plugged into content producers and creators, and be willing to start from zero — shooting, editing, briefing, whatever the moment needs.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration*** Partner with Influencer \& GTM and Commercial to build content that compounds momentum instead of resetting it.
* Design for the online\-to\-offline journey — how discovery on a screen turns into a moment IRL.
* Keep storytelling consistent with Creative, Retail and PR — one world, every channel.

**Data \& Platform Mastery*** Understand how the algorithm actually works, on each platform, and use that to shape format — not just timing.
* Bring an analytical brain: track performance, find the signal, feed it back to the team as direction.
* Test, learn, refine — every post is a small experiment inside a much bigger one.

**How We Sound (and How You Should Too)**
=========================================


Our words matter as much as our fumes. A few house rules you'll need to live inside:* Sniff, never smell. Fumes, not scents. Wax, not candle.
* Fancy, not precious. Grand, with a wink. Cheeky and original. Anti\-corporate by instinct.
* We reference music, not beauty — remixes and mixtapes, not flankers.
* If it sounds like advertising, we don't say it — unless we're poking fun at advertising.
* No “discover this.” No “captivate your senses.” No phony indulgence. If it's too polished, too earnest or too corporate, it's wrong.

new_jobs.description:
Overview:

The Manager, Brand Marketing, Basketball for Foot Locker, will serve as a strategic leader within the Brand Marketing organization, responsible for shaping and executing initiatives that deepen Foot Locker’s connection to Basketball \& Sneaker culture. Working closely with the Director of Marketing, this individual will execute the end\-to\-end campaign strategy, partnership relationships, and cross\-functional alignment across brand, retail, and digital channels. This role requires a highly strategic, solutions\-oriented thinker with strong leadership and communication skills who can balance creative vision with operational excellence. The ideal candidate is proactive, collaborative, and passionate about driving cultural relevance and business impact through sport.  

Great brands reflect culture. The best ones help shape it. At Foot Locker, we’re rooted in sport, powered by style, and driven by the communities that move both. From Foot Locker and Kids Foot Locker to Champs Sports, WSS, and atmos, our brands sit at the intersection of sport, style, and self\-expression.  

As part of the DICK’S Sporting Goods family, you’re backed by the resources, reach, and career opportunities of a world\-class sports company. That unleashes Foot Locker to keep pushing forward with the agility and edge that define the brand. We’re looking for great people who want to influence culture and the generation that is shaping what’s next.  

Whether you’re building strategy, shaping innovations, or creating unforgettable customer moments, you’ll contribute to decisions and experiences that define our brands’ impact in the communities we serve.  

Come change the game with us. Apply today!  


Responsibilities:
* **Basketball Category Expertise:** Leverage deep knowledge of basketball, sports culture, athletes, and fandom to identify emerging trends and cultural moments, translating them into timely, relevant marketing campaigns and consumer experiences.
* **Strategic Brand Leadership:** Drive the development and execution of the annual sports marketing strategy, connecting brand storytelling, basketball culture, and commercial priorities across Foot Locker’s ecosystem.
* **Campaign Development:** Oversee concept development and creative execution for basketball\-related campaigns, ensuring integration across digital, experiential, and retail touchpoints.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with internal teams—including Creative, VM, Retail Marketing, and Social—to ensure seamless execution and measurement of campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, and sell\-through.
* **Partnership and Budget Management:** Lead external partnership relationships, scopes of work, and creative development processes; manage budgets, timelines, and deliverables with accountability and precision.
* **Brand Strategy Alignment:** Ensure all sports marketing programs ladder up to Foot Locker’s strategic basketball pillars and reflect our positioning as The Home Court for Young Hoopers.
* **Performance Reporting \& Insights:** Define success metrics, measure campaign performance, and translate learnings into actionable insights to optimize future initiatives.
* **Product \& Campaign Integration:** Partner closely with Merchandising to identify priority basketball products, signature launches, mapping them to the marketing calendar and translating them into consumer\-facing stories and moments.


Qualifications:
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in sports marketing or related role, with a proven track record of managing successful campaigns and partnerships
* Strong understanding of the sports industry, including knowledge of sponsorships, fan engagement, and media relations
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams and external partners (agencies, vendors, sports organizations)
* Confident manager and problem\-solver with ability to work in a deadline driven work environment, attention to detail, and ability to multitask
* Passion for basketball and sneakers

The annual base salary range is $82,000\-$90,000\. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary for this position. Every contribution counts. When we win, we win together.

We are scaling rapidly and on a clear trajectory toward becoming a unicorn this year — and beyond. Our growth is not accidental; it’s the result of disciplined execution, relentless focus, and a team that refuses to settle. We are building a category\-defining company, and we’re looking for people who want to do the most meaningful work of their careers.

If you want comfort, this isn’t the place.
If you want impact, ownership, and the chance to help build a generational fintech company, welcome.

Nitra was created by unicorn founders who have successfully scaled to thousands of customers and exited $1B\+ public offerings. * We are seeking a BDR Manager located in the NY area. This individual will lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team of Business Development Representatives responsible for generating pipeline through extensive outbound prospecting and cold calling.
* The ideal candidate is a hands\-on, experienced sales leader who can immediately step in and lead a BDR organization. You should have a proven track record of managing high\-volume outbound teams, coaching reps to success, and building a culture of accountability and performance.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of BDRs to consistently achieve and exceed pipeline and activity targets.

* Own team performance metrics, identify areas for improvement, and implement strategies to increase productivity and conversion.
* Develop and refine outbound messaging, call scripts, prospecting strategies, and sales processes.
* Attend conferences and industry events to support lead generation and prospect engagement.

### **You have:**

* Proven track record of building and managing successful outbound teams with a strong emphasis on cold calling.

* Experience recruiting, onboarding, training, and developing BDR talent.
* Strong understanding of BDR metrics, sales processes, and pipeline generation.
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to motivate a team while maintaining a high standard of accountability.
* Highly competitive, driven, and results\-oriented with a passion for sales and developing people.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, 100% in\-person environment and willing to be hands\-on with the team.
* Experience selling into healthcare is a plus.

### **We offer:**

* Equity \- Everyone at Nitra is an owner. When the company wins, you win
* Competitive Salary \- You’re the best of the best, and your salary will reflect your experience and reward your contributions to Nitra
* Health Care \- Your health comes first. We offer comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance options.

Nitra values diversity. We are committed to equal opportunities and creating an inclusive environment for all our employees.
