new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Pet Specialty
new_jobs.description:
**Key Account Manager – Pet**  

**Location:** Atlanta, GA (In\-Office)  

**Reports to:** Sr. Sales Manager  

**Category Focus:** Pet Specialty Channel  

  

**About Inaba Foods (USA) Inc.**  

Inaba Foods is a manufacturer of premium pet food, treats, toppers, and complements, deeply rooted in a family tradition of excellence that spans generations. Since 1958, pet parents have trusted Inaba to deliver products that are human\-grade, nutrient\-rich, and designed to bring joy to pets.  

  

Today, Inaba is the most popular brand of premium cat and dog dinners and treats in Japan, with growing distribution throughout the United States and globally. Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. continues to expand its footprint, invest in talent, and build long\-term partnerships across the pet industry, supported by the stability and vision of our Japanese parent company.  

  

**Position Summary**  

Inaba Foods (USA) Inc. is seeking a Key Account Manager – Pet to develop and manage strategic relationships at the headquarters and regional level with national and regional retailers, as well as distributors, within the Pet Specialty channel. This role is responsible for driving growth, expanding distribution, and strengthening long\-term partnerships while collaborating closely with internal teams to execute sales strategies.  

  

This is a full\-time, in\-office position based in Atlanta, GA, as required by company leadership.  

  

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Grow distribution and sales volume within assigned Pet Specialty accounts
* Strengthen distributor relationships to expand market presence and execution
* Become a trusted partner to customers through strategic planning and consistent engagement
* Contribute to category growth through promotions, pricing strategies, and market insights
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to support forecasting, production planning, and account strategy

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and distributors, nurturing existing business and driving incremental growth
* Analyze historical and current purchase order data to project sales, assess profitability, and identify growth opportunities
* Lead and participate in customer business reviews and market presentations
* Maintain regular engagement with accounts to ensure customer needs are met or exceeded
* Execute promotional strategies and programs to drive volume and brand visibility
* Provide sales forecasts and input for production and demand planning
* Collaborate with executive leadership on pricing, promotions, quotes, and account strategies
* Resolve customer issues related to product, service, or sales execution
* Monitor competitive activity, market trends, and merchandising techniques
* Manage expenses in alignment with budgeted guidelines
* Demonstrate a growth\-oriented, proactive sales approach focused on building and expanding strategic relationships
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards while representing Inaba in a professional manner
* Perform additional duties as assigned

  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field
* 3–7 years of experience in sales within Pet Specialty, Food \& Beverage, or adjacent CPG categories
* Experience calling on headquarters, regional offices, and/or managing distributor relationships
* Strong ability to analyze trends, data, and sales performance metrics
* Proficiency in creating compelling PowerPoint sales presentations
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities
* Experience working cross\-functionally with internal teams and external partners
* Ability to travel locally or regionally as needed, including time spent in the field
* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software

 **Why Join Inaba Foods**

* Growing U.S. business with expanding distribution and increasing market presence
* Long\-term stability and leadership from a well\-established Japanese parent company
* Opportunity to manage meaningful accounts and influence growth strategy
* Collaborative, professional environment with a strong brand reputation

  

  

Inaba Foods is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment laws, including California’s Fair Employment and Housing Act.

  

This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

**Company Overview**

  


Richelieu is a leading North American distributor, importer, and manufacturer of specialty hardware and complementary products. Our products are targeted to an extensive customer base of kitchen and bathroom cabinet, storage and closet, home furnishing and office furniture manufacturers, door and window, residential and commercial woodworkers, and hardware retailers including renovation superstores. Richelieu offers customers a broad mix of high\-end products sourced from manufacturers worldwide. * Learn and stay abreast of products, changes, and trends within woodworking, kitchen \& bath design, and cabinet making
* Seek out new business opportunities with customers via phone, placing orders as well as providing sales quotes

* Hours of operation are Monday to Friday, day shift only

* A motivated, customer\-focused individual, eager to provide top\-quality customer experiences when ordering or installing Richelieu products

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; must be able to effectively use Word, Outlook , and Excel for daily responsibilities and tasks

**Job Overview**

The Assistant Project Manager (APM) supports the Project Manager and Superintendent in the successful planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of ground\-up multifamily construction projects. This position is responsible for helping manage project documentation, subcontractor coordination, procurement, cost control, scheduling, change management, and communication between the field, ownership, design team, and subcontractors.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, technically capable, and interested in developing into a Project Manager role within the multifamily construction industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Management \& Coordination**

* Assist the Project Manager with the day\-to\-day management of multifamily construction projects from preconstruction through closeout.
* Coordinate with the Superintendent, subcontractors, architects, engineers, consultants, vendors, and ownership representatives.
* Participate in owner, architect, contractor (OAC) meetings and subcontractor coordination meetings.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action\-item lists, and follow\-up documentation.
* Help identify project risks, delays, scope gaps, and coordination issues before they impact the schedule or budget.

**Submittals \& RFIs**

* Manage and maintain project submittal logs.
* Review subcontractor submittals for completeness prior to forwarding them to the design team.
* Track submittal approvals and ensure materials are released in accordance with the project schedule.
* Prepare, issue, and track Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Coordinate RFI responses with the field team and affected subcontractors.
* Maintain current construction drawings, specifications, ASIs, RFIs, and other project documents.

**Procurement \& Subcontractor Management**

* Assist with subcontractor bidding, bid leveling, scope review, and contract preparation.
* Help confirm subcontractor scopes are complete and consistent with project plans and specifications.
* Track subcontract agreements, purchase orders, insurance requirements, and required documentation.
* Maintain procurement logs for long\-lead materials and equipment.
* Coordinate material releases and delivery requirements with the project schedule.

**Cost Management**

* Assist with maintaining project budgets, commitments, and cost reports.
* Review subcontractor change\-order requests and supporting documentation.
* Prepare potential change orders and owner change\-order documentation.
* Track project contingency, allowances, and pending cost exposures.
* Assist with subcontractor pay applications and monthly owner billing.
* Verify that subcontractor billing corresponds with actual work completed in the field.

**Scheduling**

* Work with the Project Manager and Superintendent to maintain the overall construction schedule.
* Assist with preparation and distribution of two\-week and three\-week look\-ahead schedules.
* Monitor procurement activities and subcontractor commitments against schedule requirements.
* Identify activities that could affect critical\-path construction.
* Help coordinate building turnover, inspections, punch\-list activities, and unit delivery schedules.

**Field Coordination**

* Maintain a regular presence in the field and work closely with the Superintendent and Assistant Superintendent.
* Review construction progress against plans, specifications, and project requirements.
* Participate in quality\-control inspections and punch walks.
* Assist with resolving field coordination issues involving multiple trades.
* Track completion of corrective work and outstanding punch\-list items.
* Help coordinate municipal inspections, third\-party inspections, testing, and owner inspections.

**Project Documentation**

* Maintain organized and accurate electronic project files.
* Track RFIs, submittals, change orders, procurement, inspections, meeting minutes, and other project correspondence.
* Help maintain current drawing sets and ensure field personnel have access to the latest documents.
* Assist in maintaining daily and weekly reporting as required.
* Document significant project issues and decisions through written correspondence.

**Project Closeout**

* Coordinate collection of warranties, attic stock, spare materials, operation and maintenance manuals, and closeout documentation.
* Track subcontractor punch\-list completion.
* Assist with obtaining final inspections, Certificates of Occupancy, and other required approvals.
* Coordinate turnover documentation with ownership and property management.
* Assist with subcontractor final payments, lien releases, and project financial closeout.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Building Construction, Engineering, Architecture, or related field preferred.
* 3–5 years of commercial or multifamily construction experience preferred.
* Experience with ground\-up multifamily, wood\-frame, podium, garden\-style, wrap, or similar residential construction is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, contracts, submittals, RFIs, and change orders.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing and subcontractor coordination.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and construction management software.
* Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, BuildingConnected, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced construction environment.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to recognize potential scope, cost, and schedule issues.
* Ability to work collaboratively with office and field personnel.

**Preferred Multifamily Experience**

Experience with some or all of the following is preferred:

* Wood\-frame multifamily construction
* Unit turnover and phased building delivery
* Building envelope and waterproofing
* MEP coordination
* Elevators
* Fire

wholesale\-broker experience that translates.

### **About CJE SeniorLife**



CJE SeniorLife is a leading provider of services for older adults, dedicated to enhancing quality of life through compassionate care, innovation, and community engagement. Guided by our mission to support older adults in living with dignity, purpose, and connection, we provide a comprehensive range of programs and services that meet the evolving needs of the communities we serve.

* Achieve annual and quarterly sales and revenue targets.
* Prospect and generate new business opportunities through outbound outreach, referrals, networking, conferences, and strategic partnerships.
* Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline across multiple stages of the sales cycle.
* Conduct virtual and in\-person product demonstrations and presentations.
